params.message:
Google Ads: one conversion per route, phone and WhatsApp at the click

The old site counts two Google Ads conversions, a click on the phone
number and a click on WhatsApp, each with its own label, plus GA4
events "Telefoon website" and "Whatsapp klik". The new site had one
label for every route and fired it on the page after the lead, which
for phone and WhatsApp is the next page the visitor happens to open.

- tracing.ads_labels: TRACING_ADS_LABEL_TEL, _WHATSAPP and _REQUEST
  replace TRACING_ADS_CONVERSION_LABEL. A route without a label sends
  no Ads conversion.
- Phone and WhatsApp fire at the click (beacon transport), with the old
  GA4 event names (tracing.ga4_click_events), only once the tags are
  loaded after consent.
- A sent form (contact, price proposal, valuation) still fires
  generate_lead and the request conversion on the page after it.
  LeadRecorder no longer flashes lead_event for phone and WhatsApp.
- DEPLOY.md lists the old site's ids and labels for go-live.
